$comment: Single source of truth for repos that require a PR workflow to master. Consumed by hooks/protect-branches.ts (blocks Claude from pushing to master) and scripts/github-config.sh (applies the FULL require-PR ruleset; everything else gets the LITE ruleset). IuRoot repos are PR-required by path and handled separately in the hook. Add a repo to `repos` to enforce PRs in both layers at once. `directToMain` is the inverse escape hatch: repos listed there are NEVER PR-required even when they'd otherwise match (e.g. a greenfield single-operator agent under ~/IuRoot/) — the hook lets Claude push straight to main. github-config.sh ignores `directToMain` (it only reads `.repos`, and is GitHub-only anyway). Symlinked to ~/.claude/pr-required-repos.json by `make setup`.
